dataset.name: Matched neoadjuvant-ADT prostate cohort, pretreatment biopsies (GSE111177)
dataset.description: Independent prostate-cancer cohort with pretreatment tumor-biopsy bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study generated whole-transcriptome profiles from 20 patient-matched pretreatment needle-core biopsies and post-ADT prostatectomy specimens. TRACE Explorer retains one pretreatment biopsy per patient and links it to exact overall-survival follow-up in the public clinical workbook. Four additional paired GEO patients without records in that workbook are excluded before analysis.

metadata.source_program: Matched neoadjuvant androgen-deprivation therapy prostate-cancer study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus, MDPI and Europe PMC
metadata.library_method: Whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing of FFPE prostate needle-core biopsies obtained before neoadjuvant ADT; GEO reports STAR 2.5 alignment to hg38 and GENCODE v21 annotation.
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival from diagnosis to death from any cause or last follow-up
metadata.endpoint_definition_note: The source workbook defines dx_lasttime as months from diagnosis to last follow-up and vital_status as 0=alive, 1=dead from prostate cancer and 2=dead from another cause. TRACE Explorer treats both death codes as OS events.
metadata.sample_linkage_note: GEO titles and the clinical workbook use the same CHU patient/specimen identifiers. The public GSE111177_Sample-key.xlsx file maps each pretreatment title to its raw-count matrix column; the exact mapping is frozen in the study specification.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The treatment=pre-ADT filter identifies 24 source biopsies or TURP specimens. Twenty standard pretreatment biopsies map one-to-one to the public clinical workbook and expression columns; four endpoint-unlinked profiles are excluded.
metadata.expression_processing_note: TRACE Explorer computes library sizes from all 60,155 released Ensembl rows, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps versioned Ensembl gene identifiers against the source-declared pinned GENCODE v21 annotation, and excludes symbols represented by multiple Ensembl genes rather than silently aggregating them.
metadata.overlap_note: The CHU and Emory/CRCHUM neoadjuvant-ADT cohort is independent of TCGA-PRAD and of the other prostate-cancer cohorts currently promoted in the repository.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Direct source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the article's CC BY 4.0 license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: One FFPE prostate needle-core biopsy collected before neoadjuvant ADT per patient

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned GENCODE v21 hg38 gene_name annotation declared by the source
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols assigned to more than one Ensembl gene are excluded rather than silently combined.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer calculates CPM from all 60,155 released source rows before applying log2(CPM + 1), then maps Ensembl identifiers with pinned GENCODE v21. Values support within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Overall survival from diagnosis
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause; source vital_status 1 and 2 are events and 0 denotes censoring
